# ERC1155FullSupply
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/extensions/ERC1155FullSupply.sol)

**Inherits:**
ERC1155Supply, [IERC1155FullSupply](../interfaces/extensions/ERC1155FullSupply/ierc1155-full-supply.md)

**Title:**
ERC1155FullSupply

**Author:**
robercano

Extension of OpenZeppelin's `ERC1155Supply` that additionally tracks each account's total
balance across every token id, so callers can query the per-account aggregate in O(1)
instead of enumerating ids.

Implementations that mint multi-id receipts use `balanceOfAll` as the cheap aggregate
readout (e.g. `RoundsVaultBase` uses it for minimum-position-size checks).


## State Variables
### _totalSupplyByAccount
STORAGE

Sum of an account's balances across every id, maintained by `_update`.


```solidity
mapping(address => uint256) private _totalSupplyByAccount
```


## Functions
### balanceOfAll

READ FUNCTIONS


```solidity
function balanceOfAll(address account) public view virtual override returns (uint256);
```

### _update

INTERNAL FUNCTIONS

ERC-1155 `_update` hook. Delegates the per-id supply bookkeeping to `ERC1155Supply` and
maintains the per-account aggregate `_totalSupplyByAccount` so `balanceOfAll` is O(1).


```solidity
function _update(
    address from,
    address to,
    uint256[] memory ids,
    uint256[] memory values
)
    internal
    virtual
    override;
```
